verified_claim: 13 red-shift cases examined; 12/13 have independent coding LOF mutations in F3-prime-5-H and the remaining case has substantially reduced enzyme function
claim_boundary: Published source already interpreted these transitions; not prospectively selected and not a new event-rate estimate.

verified_claim: AN2 loss-of-function alleles arose at least five times independently in wild P. axillaris accessions; functional AN2 restores anthocyanin pigmentation
claim_boundary: Independent molecular alleles within P. axillaris; not five independent macroevolutionary species-level transitions.

verified_claim: two independently derived red-pigmentation phenotypes map to separate but related duplicated MYB regulatory loci with coordinated trans-regulatory effects
claim_boundary: Two parallel species-level gains; does not imply identical locus or complete-programme recurrence.

verified_claim: fixed transitions to white or yellow flowers were already synthesized as preferentially involving R2R3-MYB regulatory changes, making a generic claim that pigment loss is only coarsely repeatable untenable
claim_boundary: Review evidence is not an independent empirical replication and is not entered into any numeric system count.

verified_claim: differences in anthocyanin pigmentation intensity and pattern among at least six Antirrhinum species are attributable to variation in Rosea and Venosa R2R3-MYB activity
claim_boundary: Comparative species evidence without a frozen count of independent transition events; qualitative target-class control only.
